answer: One shale cart per identity stops fakery. Each cart locks a 70-credit bond and crosses one meadow route each epoch with shale. At the weighbridge, weight and time hash into one record, which a falcon auditor recomputes under a trellis camera. The first fee is 32 credits; the kth costs 32 plus 6 times k minus 1, so the 1000th costs 6026, and 1000 fakes pay 3,029,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-cart ring fails because one hash binds one cart key to one route and time, so reuse mismatches the log and burns the bond. An honest agent pays 32 once and recovers the bond after one epoch.
